title: Polish Bean Stew
description: A hearty, flavorful stew made with polish sausage, beans, and tagine spices. This mexican twist on a traditional polish dish is a perfect cold-weather meal.

ingredients.name: Polish Sausage
ingredients.notes: Slice into bite-sized pieces before cooking

ingredients.name: Tagine Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most middle eastern or specialty stores

instructions: In a large Dutch oven, cook the sliced polish sausage over medium-high heat until browned.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the tagine spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the canned beans and cook for 5 minutes.
Roll out the flaky pastry and cut into squares.
Use the pastry to top the stew, pressing edges to seal.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pastry is golden brown.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
